resources.string: Background checks for new training sessions in Google Calendar
Alarm reminders for upcoming training sessions
Training Reminder needs access to your Calendar to find your training sessions and schedule alarms for them. Your events never leave this device.
Notification access is needed so the alarm can alert you when a training session is about to start.
Allow exact alarms so reminders fire at the precise time, 15 minutes before each session.
Events from your Google Calendar matching your filter will show up here
e.g. training (leave blank for all events)
